verdict.rationale: A feature-flag SaaS could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows none. The MCP server only lets external AI assistants act through the Admin API. That is an integration building block belonging to a different story, not a built-in assistant. The "intelligent release assistant" phrasing describes rule-based Release Pipeline automation, an adjacent feature rather than an AI assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
